snippet.title: SONIC PICO PARK - Summer Game Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing SONIC PICO PARK! 

The latest entry in the worldwide hit PICO PARK series was made in celebration of our 35th anniversary this year! 

Stay tuned for more information!
